facts.fact: Mmegi reports that the Data Protection Act, in effect since January 2025, allows data transfers abroad only to approved countries and requires a copy of the data to remain in Botswana; the report is dated 2025-11-25 and gives no other date for the statement.

systems.tiers: government services to migrate from the Department of Shared Digital Services

note: The minister's wish to amend the Act to compel all businesses to store data in Botswana is a stated intention with no drafting reported, so no draft fact; no enforcer or application named.
